routine_definition:
insert into ai_usage (identity, day, count)
  values (p_identity, p_day, 1)
  on conflict (identity, day) do update
    set count = ai_usage.count + 1
  returning count;

insert into api_usage (api, date, count)
  values (p_api, p_date, p_n)
  on conflict (api, date) do update
    set count = api_usage.count + excluded.count
  returning count;
